entries.1c1b6b983128c63a: It is a business that contracts out software development and system operation. Software development includes both work performed on-site at the customer's offices and work performed within the company. System operation involves working on-site at the customer's offices to carry out information system operation tasks and operations management, as well as designing and building servers and networks. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥9,967 million, accounting for the majority of total revenue.
entries.1cbab77b53ac6eca: It is a business that develops, sells and supports the introduction of in-house products and services. Its main services are the cloud-based ticket sales service 'Ticket for LINE Hybrid' and 'Rakuraku Nyujo Service HINORI', and the individual ability development support system 'iDEP' for sports and education. The consolidated subsidiary Feet Co., Ltd. provides the communication support apps for people with hearing impairments 'Koetora' and 'SpeechCanvas', and the device 'Sound Pipette', which picks up sound from a target area clearly in noisy environments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥168 million, down from the prior year due to factors including the transfer of part of development work for major customers to the IT Solutions Business.
